propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 commonmark-to-jira conversion corrupts code spans by escaping arrows, deletes HTML comments, and requires post-render code-preservation checks to prevent silent data loss

A two-phase left-to-right lexer must lock complete {noformat} spans, HTML comments, backtick/tilde fences, and four-space blocks before classifying intervening text to preserve inline Jira syntax and prevent cross-delimiter arrow rewrites

The renderer must classify markdown units in order: locked blocks, Jira inline syntax (bold/italic/link/color/monospace), ASCII tables (wrapped in {noformat}), HTML tags, regex-dangerous prose, then fallback to pypandoc with preservation validation or identity fallback when pandoc is absent

Arrow substitution (-> <- <-> =>) must map to single-pass regex in order (<!-- --> <-> -> <- =>) before classifiers and skip code fragments; HTML comment delimiters must be consumed to prevent --> being rewritten to -→

A 178-body deterministic corpus (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) with >=0.90 body ratio and >=0.95 character ratio must render through real pandoc; five-pass idempotency tests prove passes 2–5 byte-identical

pypandoc-binary==1.15 with bundled pandoc 3.6.1 must be pinned in wiki extra, optional alongside agents and tracing, with non-skipping hard-import tests on Linux/macOS confirming exact versions and jira writer availability
